title: Amazingly Dense Slovakian Pork Casserole
description: A hearty and dense Slovakian dish featuring pork, grand marnier, and a bain-marie cooking method, perfect for a low-fat meal prep option. This casserole is a unique and flavorful twist on traditional Slovakian cuisine.

ingredients.name: pork shoulder
ingredients.notes: boneless and trimmed of excess fat

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the pork shoulder and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the grand marnier, chicken broth, tomato paste, and thyme, stirring to combine.
Cover the Dutch oven and transfer to the preheated oven.
Cook for 2.5 hours, or until the pork is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
